severity_assessment: HIGH conditional menu/inventory integrity risk for authorized recipe editor; source interleaving supported, runtime corruption NOT tested.

evidence.evidence: Each actual selection property change invokes LoadDetailAsync directly, bypassing relay-command concurrency guard; no generation/cancellation.
Captures row before await, then unconditionally assigns Detail and sets shared IsDetailLoading false; no selected recipe recheck.
ListView selected item is TwoWay and selection remains enabled while loading detail.
StartEdit copies current Detail lines to independent EditorLines and makes IsEditing true.
Later Detail change refreshes display DetailLines, but does not cancel edit or rebuild EditorLines.
Save takes current Detail recipe/product/name identity and separately built EditorLines, enabling stale identity/editor mismatch.
Visible detail header names Detail.ProductName/Name, and edit entry is shown only CanStartEdit; this can warn attentive operator and prevents claiming invisible guaranteed corruption.

supported_interleavings: Select A then B; B completes first; A completes later. SelectedRecipe stays B while Detail becomes A. Editing thereafter targets displayed A despite selected B.
Stronger mismatch: Select A then B; B completes; StartEdit(B) populates EditorLines B; late A completes and changes Detail only; SaveAsync then combines identity A with independent edited lines B.
preconditions: Authorized recipe editor, at least two recipes, overlapping detail reads with reversed completion.
Operator performs edit/save after stale publication, or starts edit after B completion before late A.
counterevidence: Right-hand detail header shows actual Detail name, so operator may notice mismatch.
Selection change cancels edit at selection time, but it does not cancel outstanding reads or edits started after the selection change.
Save snapshots d before its HTTP await; finding concerns mismatch before Save begins, not arbitrary retargeting after request dispatch.
No UI-native observation or actual recipe writes executed.
recommended_remediation: Validate a selection generation after every asynchronous boundary; bind editor immutable recipe identity and invalidate stale detail completions before publishing.
required_tests: Controlled TaskCompletionSource A/B reversed responses: Detail must remain B.
B completes and edit begins; A completes; Save request must retain B identity and B lines.
Clear selection and navigate away while request pending must not republish detail.
independent_scope: UI-018 only; no global recipe function completion claimed
